mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals tight labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a falling housing starts (HOUST) indicates economic activity shift toward services, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO rises > 0.5% and HOUST falls > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0) and low interest rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5) regime, accommodative monetary policy sustains equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: low inflation and low interest rate
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 2.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, increasing corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly non-farm payrolls increase (PAYEMS) exceeding 200,000 persons signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS change exceeds 200.

mechanism_narrative: Rising real savings (RSAFS) combined with falling federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates increased consumer spending and lower borrowing costs, jointly driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: increased consumer spending and lower borrowing costs
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS rises > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS falls > 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong industrial production (INDPRO > 101.0) and weak housing starts (HOUST < 590.0) regime, manufacturing-driven economic growth supports corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 101.0 and HOUST < 590.0.
